notes.drawing: Side view, direction A as sketched in round 1: a shell dome on a flat base, the head a pill held low and forward with its underside in line with the base, two legs and a short tail. The dome is half an ellipse (168 wide, 112 high, as cubics) instead of the sketch's half circle, so the turtle stands y 32 to 200 outside the stroke (the sketch was 120 units tall beside rabbit's 232). The legs are stubs 40 long that taper from 40 (back leg 36) to 24 units and splay outwards (back leg backwards, front leg forwards), so they read as legs and not as wheels. Round 2's raised head and rim line were dropped: with the rim, the round feet read as a little car at 16 px.
notes.bold: No override: at 24 the legs close up into solid tapered stubs, which still read as legs, and the head keeps a 16-unit opening.
notes.fill: Shell, head and legs solid; the tail stays a line.
